names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Ησύχιος ο Ιεροσολυμίτης», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's third heading for the Julian 28 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Преподобни Исихије Јерусалимски.“, with the rank word Преподобни left off. Јерусалимски is kept: he is a presbyter and not a bishop, so it is a by-name of place and not a see, and it is what this folder's English name already carries. A bare Исихије would stand too close to `hesychius-the-faster`'s «Исихије Посник».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Ησύχιος ο Ιεροσολυμίτης»

attestations.note: The page is unusually source-conscious: it separates what the Synaxarion says from what Theophanes adds in his Chronography — that the ordination fell just as Cyril became archbishop of Alexandria, in 412 — and from what Cyril of Scythopolis, who knows the matter from local tradition, gives, namely the titles «πρεσβύτερος και της Εκκλησίας διδάσκαλος», «πεφωτισμένος», «θεολόγος», «φωστήρ», and the report that Hesychius was in Patriarch Juvenal's company at the consecration of the church of Euthymius's monastery in 428 or 429. It cites the Acts of the Fifth Council of 553 for a fragment of his Ecclesiastical History, and reports his tomb still being shown about 570 at the eastern gate of Jerusalem. It prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 10.04.2026 (28. март ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Исихије Јерусалимски.“

attestations.note: The day's third entry, on the same menologion day the Greek already keeps in this folder, and the same presbyter and theologian of Palestine. This folder held a `floruit` of the fifth century and **no death at all**, and the entry gives one: „Упокојио се мирно око 434. године“, about 434, which falls inside that century, so the century stands untouched and the death is recorded beside it, on the shape `piamoun` already uses. It makes him a disciple of Gregory the Theologian, which neither other page did, and `related` goes both ways for that; `euthymius-the-great`, whose contemporary it also calls him, was already related here. It names a work of his on sobriety and prayer and recommends reading it; nothing was taken from that, because a title in a recommendation is not a folder's data. The stored form keeps Јерусалимски, the by-name the heading gives him; a bare Исихије would stand against `hesychius-the-faster`'s «Исихије Посник» with nothing to tell them apart. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Ησύχιος έζησε και ασκήτεψε στην Παλαιστίνη κατά τον 5ο αιώνα μ.Χ.» The page gives no year of birth and none of death; the years it does give belong to other men's acts — Cyril's accession in 412, Juvenal's patriarchate — and are not his.

death.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 28 March: „Упокојио се мирно око 434. године.“ The page says about the year 434, not 434, and it is the only source read for this folder that gives a year of any kind; the floruit beside this is saint.gr's century. The two do not conflict: 434 falls inside the century, and nothing of the century's interval was narrowed.
